For an explicit list of supplier ABNs, split then validate each ABN, or regex with all:true then abn; set separate_entities:true on the identifier mapping to emit separately scoped identifier-only claims. No names/addresses are assigned to those parties. This safe capability resolves compound identifier lists. Correct invalid transforms, weak semantic mappings, and fields with poor coverage. Return {config:<complete revised config>, changes:[{field,before,after,reason}], semantic_risks:[...], requires_human_review:true}. Explicitly retain mappings only with defensible evidence.
